title: LCLI-702 round-2 minors: the test header map, the CheckRule "one rule" doc block, and the CHANGELOG's single budget
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from LCLI-702's round-2 review (three MINOR findings; factual corrections, no design call). All three are records that LCLI-702 made stale:

1. `test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts`'s own header map (its tag list and case counts) does not list the 4 new `[multi-pin]` cases and still says "the 12 cases here" / "4 of 12". The map's stated purpose is that a mutation subset can be predicted from the file alone, so it must list every case and count correctly.
2. `src/core/check.ts`'s `CheckRule` doc block calls `agent-profile-capacity` "the one rule whose severity is not fixed at its call site but named by AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY". After LCLI-702 a second rule is named by a constant (`agent-profile-pin-capacity`, `AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY`), so "the one rule" under-describes the set.
3. The CHANGELOG's LCLI-702 Added bullet says implementation's budget "rises to 111000 ... so the new gate passes here", implying it was the only budget that had to move. `verification.toml` also moved (96523 -> 97000) because it names the same grown source (`reference/cli-contract`).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The header map in test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts lists the 4 [multi-pin] cases, and its case counts match the file.

The CheckRule doc block in src/core/check.ts (the sentence calling agent-profile-capacity "the one rule whose severity is not fixed at its call site") no longer says "the one rule"; it names both rules that use a named severity constant (AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY and AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY).
The CHANGELOG entry for LCLI-702 names both budget moves: implementation 108000 -> 111000 and verification 96523 -> 97000.

implementationNotes:
Implemented LCLI-702's three round-2 factual corrections. No behavior change — comments, one doc-prose line, and the CHANGELOG.

1. `test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts`'s header map now lists the 4 `[multi-pin]` cases, and its counts match the file: 16 cases total (`[capacity]` 2, `[count]` 2, `[measurable]` 1, `[multi-pin]` 4, `[pack-size]` 1, `[query-reserve]` 1, `[severity]` 2, `[silent]` 1, `[unmeasurable]` 2). The measured-subset paragraph is re-measured over 16 and records the [multi-pin] prediction. `[unmeasurable]` also read "3 cases" where the file has 2, so that was corrected too.
2. `src/core/check.ts`'s CheckRule doc block no longer calls `agent-profile-capacity` "the one rule whose severity is not fixed at its call site"; it names BOTH rules that use a named severity constant — `AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY` (LCLI-642) and `AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY` (LCLI-702).
3. The CHANGELOG's LCLI-702 entry names both budget moves in the same change: `implementation` 108000 -> 111000 and `verification` 96523 -> 97000 (both name the grown source).

Gates: `bun test` 5008 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail; `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lore check` (exit 0) green.

Review round 1 (review-assignment on 1815cdf6, changes-requested) — both findings were MAJOR and both were MINE: the measured-subset numbers I put in the test header map were PREDICTED from the file, not measured, and the reviewer measured them correctly.

- (major) "forcing the comparison false reddens 4 of 16" — the TRUE count is 7 of 16: the three [multi-pin] cases that need an over-capacity profile redden too. I re-measured it myself (mutating `overCapacity` to `false` at src/core/agent-context.ts:805): 9 pass / 7 fail, confirming 7. Corrected to "7 of 16", with the three [multi-pin] cases named.
- (major) "removing the pin gate reddens [multi-pin]'s failing case alone, 1 of 16" — the TRUE count is 2 of 16: the pinned-only case also asserts the gate's finding, so it reddens too. I re-measured it myself (neutering `agentProfilePinCapacityFindings` to `return []`): 14 pass / 2 fail, confirming 2. Corrected to "the failing and pinned-only [multi-pin] cases, 2 of 16".

The paragraph now states that every count was measured by applying the mutation. Both mutations were then reverted; `git diff` on both source files is empty, and the header-map fix is the only change in this commit.

Gates: `bun test` 5008 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail; `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lore check` (exit 0) green.
finalSummary: LCLI-702's three round-2 factual corrections (no behavior change): the capacity test's header map lists the 4 [multi-pin] cases with counts matching the file (16 total; [unmeasurable] corrected 3 -> 2); the CheckRule doc block names BOTH rules that use a named severity constant (AGENT_PROFILE_CAPACITY_SEVERITY and AGENT_PROFILE_PIN_CAPACITY_SEVERITY) instead of calling agent-profile-capacity "the one rule"; and the CHANGELOG's LCLI-702 entry names both budget moves (implementation 108000 -> 111000 and verification 96523 -> 97000).
